why: First consultation free on all matters
Tax experts with over 20 years of experience
Specialists in property development and structuring
Fixed fee services. No more shock bills
Tailored support and service packages based on your needs

qa.q: What services do you offer?
qa.also: what do you do, services, help with, accountant, accounting, tax help, what can you do
qa.a: We work in four areas: Taxation & Accounting Compliance (tax returns, GST, PAYE, financial statements, bookkeeping and tax planning), Business Advisory & Planning (business plans, cashflow forecasting and coaching), Employment & HR Advisory (agreements, policies, accreditation, restructures and disputes) and Property Investment & Development (strategy, structuring, returns and cash flow tools).

qa.q: Is the first consultation free?
qa.also: free consultation, first meeting free, free chat, no charge, first appointment cost, initial consultation
qa.a: The first consultation is free on all matters. For Business Planning, the first meeting is also free of charge.

qa.q: How much do you charge?
qa.also: price, prices, cost, fees, how much, rates, quote, expensive, fixed fee, monthly fee, charges
qa.a: We work on fixed fees, so there are no shock bills. Fees depend on what you need (for rental property clients, for example, they vary with the size of the portfolio), so our prices aren't on the website. The first consultation is free, and we'll give you the fee before any work starts.

qa.q: What are your opening hours?
qa.also: hours, open, opening times, when are you open, saturday, weekend, office hours, what time do you close, close, closing time, what time do you open, open today, open now
qa.a: We're open Monday to Friday, 9:30am to 5:30pm, and Saturday, 11:30am to 3:00pm. We're closed on Sunday.

qa.q: Are you open on Sunday?
qa.also: sunday, sundays, open sunday, closed sunday, public holiday open, after hours, evenings, late
qa.a: No, we're closed on Sunday. We're open Monday to Friday, 9:30am to 5:30pm, and Saturday, 11:30am to 3:00pm.

qa.q: Where are you, and is there parking?
qa.also: where are you, address, location, office, epsom, manukau road, parking, park, directions, find you
qa.a: Our office is at 620 Manukau Road, Epsom, Auckland 1023. It's central, with plenty of free on-site parking.

qa.q: How do I contact you?
qa.also: phone, phone number, call, email, contact, ring, reach, talk to someone, number
qa.a: Call us on 09 625 0035 or 09 625 0025 (press 0 for reception), or email info@taxprofessionals.co.nz. Each team member can also be reached through reception on 09 625 0025.

qa.q: How do I book an appointment?
qa.also: book, booking, appointment, meeting, make a time, see someone, come in, book a chat
qa.a: Use the Book a chat form on this page, or call 09 625 0035. The first consultation is free on all matters.

qa.q: Can you do my personal tax return?
qa.also: ir3, personal tax return, individual return, income tax return, rental return, rental property, landlord, tax refund, my taxes, ird tax return, my tax return, do my tax return, file my return, tax return for me, individual tax
qa.a: We prepare IR3 returns for individuals, rental property annual returns, returns for partners or joint holders, and look-through company returns, and we deal with Inland Revenue for you.

qa.q: Can you do accounts for my business?
qa.also: business accounts, company accounts, sole trader, partnership, company tax return, ir4, financial statements, annual accounts, small business, bookkeeping
qa.a: We look after sole traders, partnerships, companies and trusts: 2- or 6-monthly GST returns, IR4 company returns and up to two shareholders' IR3s, the annual imputation return, end-of-year financial statements, a quarterly meeting on how the business is going, and liaison with Inland Revenue.

qa.q: Can you do my GST returns?
qa.also: gst, gst return, gst filing, register for gst, gst period, goods and services tax
qa.a: We prepare 2- or 6-monthly GST returns as part of our business compliance service, and we can help with GST questions on property too.

qa.q: Do you do payroll and PAYE?
qa.also: payroll, paye, wages, payday filing, staff pay, kiwisaver employer, employees pay
qa.a: We offer full PAYE and payroll, either added to a business package or on its own.

qa.q: Do you work with Xero and MYOB?
qa.also: xero, myob, accounting software, cloud accounting, training, software help
qa.a: We work with businesses on MYOB and Xero, and our business clients get free training and ongoing support on their accounting software.

qa.q: Can you set up a company or a trust?
qa.also: company formation, set up a company, start a company, companies office, register a company, trust, family trust, set up a trust, trust administration
qa.a: We handle company formation and Companies Office records, and trust formation and management, including Family Trust Management & Advisory.

qa.q: Can you help with property investment tax?
qa.also: property, rental, investment property, look-through company, ltc, structure, structuring, developer, development, flip, trading, buy and hold, bright line, associated persons
qa.a: We specialise in property: investment strategy, structuring (personally, through a look-through company or a trust), returns and financial statements, and cash flow tools for holding and trading. Our director and partner are property investors themselves, and our director has published on New Zealand's land tax rules.

qa.q: Can you help with an IRD audit or tax debt?
qa.also: ird audit, ird debt, inland revenue audit, audit, tax debt, arrears, owe tax, letter of demand, dispute, compliance review, behind on tax
qa.a: We help with Inland Revenue compliance reviews and audits, negotiating arrears for GST, PAYE and income tax, and replying to letters of demand. Whatever the tax position, talk to us.

qa.q: What is tax pooling?
qa.also: tax pooling, tmnz, tax management nz, provisional tax, use of money interest, pay provisional tax later
qa.a: Tax pooling lets you pay provisional tax when it suits you. We offer it through Tax Management NZ (TMNZ).

qa.q: Can you help with employment and HR?
qa.also: employment, hr, human resources, employment agreement, staff, redundancy, restructure, personal grievance, dispute, labour inspector, accreditation, employer accreditation, policies
qa.a: Our Employment & HR Advisory covers employment agreements and policies, employer accreditation, restructures and redundancy, personal grievances and disputes, and getting ready for a Labour Inspector audit.

qa.q: Do you help with business planning?
qa.also: business plan, business planning, growth, strategy, coaching, cashflow forecast, cash flow, budget, forecasts, profit
qa.a: Business Planning starts with a free first meeting: a one-on-one workshop on where you want the business to be in 3 months, 12 months and 3 years. We also offer cashflow forecasting, annual budgets, management reports and monthly coaching.

qa.q: When is my tax return due?
qa.also: due date, tax return due, deadline, when do i pay, terminal tax, provisional tax dates, gst due, 7 july, extension, tax agent extension
qa.a: In general, with a 31 March balance date: income tax returns are due 7 July, or 31 March the following year if you're with a tax agent; terminal tax is due 7 February (7 April with a tax agent's extension); standard provisional tax is due 28 August, 15 January and 7 May; GST is due on the 28th of the month after the period ends, except periods ending November (15 January) and March (7 May). Your own dates may differ, and we'll confirm them.

qa.q: What if a due date falls on a weekend?
qa.also: weekend, public holiday, due on a sunday, due on a holiday, next working day
qa.a: If a payment is due on a weekend or public holiday, it's due on the next working day. GST is the exception: it's due on the last working day of the period.

qa.q: How do I pay an invoice?
qa.also: pay invoice, pay my bill, payment, credit card, visa, mastercard, direct debit, bank transfer, how to pay
qa.a: You can pay online by Visa or Mastercard, by direct deposit quoting your invoice number, by phone on 09 625 0025 or 09 625 0035 between 9:30am and 5:30pm, or by setting up a direct debit.

qa.q: Who will I deal with?
qa.also: team, staff, who works there, director, partner, ranjana, varun, eshan, accountants, people, chartered accountant
qa.a: Our team is led by Ranjana Gupta (Director; PhD, MPhil, MBus (Taxation), MCom), Varun Gupta (Partner; MBA, Chartered Accountant (NZ), Certified Business Advisor) and Eshan Gupta (Associate Partner; BCom/LLB, Barrister and Solicitor), with a team of taxation accountants and an accounts administrator.

qa.q: How long have you been in business?
qa.also: how long, since when, experience, established, history, years, trustworthy, award, been around, how long have you been around, how old is the firm, when did you start, in business
qa.a: We've been working for the community since 1998, and our tax experts have over 20 years of experience. We were named Accountant of the Year 2019-2020 at the Indian Newslink Indian Business Awards.

qa.q: Can you tell me exactly what tax I owe?
qa.also: how much tax do i owe, calculate my tax, my refund amount, personal advice, specific advice
qa.a: No, I can't work that out here: it depends on your own situation. The team can, and the first consultation is free on all matters.
